text:
jena: Quick pulse — RFC review for streaming-kv-cache is set for next Wed 10:00am PT. Need to lock authors + order and confirm pre-read deadlines. I can host the meeting.

sam: I can present the perf section, prefer slot 2. Will have slides.

mike: Slot 1 works for me (architecture + API). Can do a 20m deep-dive.

olivia: I’ll take slot 3 for rollout/testing/upgrade plan. Can also run through the canary checklist.

jena: Thanks — quick poll for order: 1) Mike 2) Sam 3) Olivia. Reply with :one: :two: :three: to confirm or suggest swaps.

anya: :two: — prefer Sam first if perf influences API surface, otherwise happy to be reviewer for perf.

mike: :one: confirmed. Mike -> Sam -> Olivia.

sam: :two: confirmed. Also can we do 10m for Q&A and 5m for rollout decisions at the end?

jena: Yup — prelim timing: Mike 20m, Sam 25m, Olivia 20m, Q&A 10m. Here's a minimal agenda to paste in calendar: 

```
1) Introductions & goals (5m)
2) Mike — architecture + API (20m)
3) Sam — perf comp + benchmarks (25m)
4) Olivia — rollout, canary, rollback plan (20m)
5) Open Q&A & decisions (10m)
6) Actions & owners (5m)
```

deploy-bot: Calendar event created: "RFC review — streaming-kv-cache". RSVP + add slides link to event.

olivia: @jena can you add the pre-read doc link in the calendar event? I’ll upload test logs by Tue.

jena: Will add pre-read by EOD today. Please have pre-reads done by Tue 5pm so we can call blockers beforehand.

infra-oncall: FYI I can surface canary metrics for the meeting. Ping me if you need any dashboards or raw traces.

sam: @anya thanks — can you take notes/CI issues during my section? Means a lot.

anya: Yep, I’ll take notes and capture action items.

mike: One ask — can we slot a short rollback drill checklist into Olivia’s section (3 slides)? Helps with decisioning.

olivia: Will do.

jena: Final checklist: slides linked in calendar, pre-read by Tue 5pm, reviewers: @anya + @infra-oncall, order confirmed (Mike -> Sam -> Olivia). If anyone needs a swap, speak now — otherwise I’ll send final agenda tomorrow AM. :thumbsup:

sam: All good from me.

mike: All set.

anya: Ready.

olivia: Thanks!

jena: Sending the agenda now. Reminder ping on Tue 3pm for last-minute blockers.
